exposure: Echo-guided trans-vaginal aspiration of the gestational sac
Systemic injection of Methotrexate (1 mg/kg within 2 days)
outcome: Success rate (absence of recourse to secondary treatment)
Secondary hysteroscopic resection of trophoblastic retention
Ultrasound diagnosis of caesarean scar defect (CSD)
cohort: The study included 35 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP), confirmed by ultrasound, without severity criteria requiring emergency surgery, between March 2015 to August 2022.
finding: The combination of transvaginal ultrasound-guided local MTX, Mifepristone and systemic MTX proved to be an effective treatment protocol for patients with CSP, achieving a 91.4% success rate.
gest_age: mean gestational age of 6.8 ± 1.6 weeks of gestation (at diagnosis/management)
